note: Authorial matter printed in the 1895 edition (scan-verified, source/SCAN-VERIFICATION.md §4) that is not part of any chapter's paragraphs. Presentation (title page, epigraph placement, part heading) is an integration decision for Codex. English renderings are Tinct translations.

items.placement: title page; the book's narrator and signatory (the Preface is signed 'Most respectfully, Johannes de silentio')

items.original: Was Tarquinius Superbus in seinem Garten mit den Mohnköpfen sprach, verstand der Sohn, aber nicht der Bote.
items.english: What Tarquinius Superbus said in his garden with the poppy heads, the son understood, but not the messenger.
items.placement: motto on the leaf before the Preface (scan leaf 10)
part title on its own leaf (scan leaf 33) before chapter 4, 'Preliminary Expectoration'; the part comprises chapters 4–7 (Preliminary Expectoration and Problemata I–III)
